therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Fludarabine phosphate and total-body irradiation conditioning with allogeneic peripheral blood stem cell transplantation
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Nonmyeloablative conditioning followed by allogeneic stem cell transplantation to provide graft-versus-leukemia effect
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Eradication of residual leukemia cells through donor immune system recognition and elimination
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with acute lymphoblastic leukemia or chronic myelogenous leukemia that has responded to treatment with imatinib mesylate, dasatinib, or nilotinib
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Relapse Free Survival assessed up to 1 year

results.effect_size: 3 out of 28 patients (10.7%) experienced relapse within 1 year
subgroup_findings: Leukemia-free survival: 19/28 at 6 months, 17/28 at 1 year, 13/28 at 2 years, 11/28 at 3-4 years, 10/28 at 5 years
Overall survival: 26/28 at 6 months, 24/28 at 1 year, 19/28 at 2 years, 17/28 at 3 years, 16/28 at 4 years, 13/28 at 5 years
safety_signals: Transplant-related mortality: 1/28 at day 100, 3/28 at 1 year
results.dose_information: Fludarabine phosphate given IV, total-body irradiation as conditioning regimen

context.duration: Treatment with up to 5 years follow-up
